title: A docs check refuses a duplicate docs id or a leftover -next id
notes: Follow-up from #352: a worker now writes a new docs id as <feature>-<kind>-next and numbers it at the final merge of main. Nothing stops a '-next' or two entries with one id from merging. Add it to pnpm lint's markdown step (and CI): every '(<feature>-<rule|decision>-<n>)' heading id is unique per feature, and none ends in -next.

comments.body: Pull request #358 opened: Lint refuses a duplicate docs heading id and a leftover -next id https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/358

Converged, ready to merge. Added the rg check for a leftover -next id to work-card's numbering step. Review loop: 2 rounds, floor-addressed. Round 1 fixed 3 (work-card greps docs and CLAUDE.md for -next; lint skips code blocks; workflow-rule-5 names docs ids). Round 2 fixed 1 nit (indented-code test), final check accepted it.
